camera_delivery.clean_phase_policy: initial excludes the last slow VAD source stamp as a one-frame transition guard; recovered begins at the first recovered VAD source stamp
camera_delivery.interpretation_boundary: camera_info is a lightweight timestamp proxy. The span localizes a serial six-camera delivery delay, but cannot by itself distinguish image conversion, reliable DDS backpressure, worker scheduling, CARLA rendering, or asset streaming.

clock_domains.host_telemetry: timezone-aware conversion of logged local timestamps

camera_hz_is_not_the_rtf_cause.explanation: The source stays at five simulation-Hz without observed VAD drops. A five-fps display can look mildly stepped at RTF~=1; wall-visible cadence is source cadence multiplied by RTF.

host_wide_saturation_is_not_supported.explanation: CPU, GPU, iowait, swap, and thermal evidence do not show host-wide exhaustion. A localized CARLA game/render-thread, render-fence, conversion, or publish wait is still possible.

candidate_triggers: cold CARLA render/asset or reliable DDS transport warm-up/backpressure
localized image conversion, worker scheduling, or reliable publish wait
single_root_cause_may_not_be_claimed.reason: In this single moving run, elapsed warm-up time and vehicle position change together at the same transition. The evidence does not experimentally separate those triggers.

gpu_device_total.boundary: nvidia-smi dmon records device totals only; CARLA, VAD, and RViz GPU shares cannot be separated from these inputs

interpretation_boundaries: camera_info is a lightweight timestamp proxy. The span localizes a serial six-camera delivery delay, but cannot by itself distinguish image conversion, reliable DDS backpressure, worker scheduling, CARLA rendering, or asset streaming.
nvidia-smi dmon records device totals only; CARLA, VAD, and RViz GPU shares cannot be separated from these inputs
pidstat %CPU is percent of one logical CPU; group values may exceed 100%.
Aggregate CPU idle does not exclude a single CARLA game-thread or render-fence wait.
This is a one-run observational change point, not a randomized causal experiment.

candidate_front_acceptance.note: candidate output count divided by recorded front-camera input count

data_quality_warnings: receipt_latency_sec uses rosbag recorder receipt time (wall/system clock)
stamp_delta_sec uses only ROS message stamps (simulation/physics clock)
receipt timestamps are never subtracted from message stamps
sensor-to-VAD pairing is a lower-bound inference: VAD output does not preserve the front-camera source stamp

latency_camera_bundle.note: camera_info is a lightweight timestamp proxy for the paired CARLA image
